environment: Local Ollama / Metal / Mac M2 Max; Java 21 / Spring AI 1.1.8 / PostgreSQL 17
comparator: Ordered result rows; aliases ignored; dates normalized to ISO date; numerical absolute tolerance 0.011 and relative tolerance 1e-9. Refusals scored separately. No judge model.

results.question: ¿Cuántas pernoctaciones hoteleras hubo en Almería en 2025?

results.actual_sql: SELECT SUM(nights_total) AS total_nights FROM fact_hotel WHERE province = 'Almería' AND year = 2025

results.actual_sql: SELECT SUM(nights_total) AS total_nights FROM fact_hotel WHERE province = 'Almería' AND year = 2024

results.question: Número estimado de hoteles abiertos en Córdoba en junio de 2025.

results.question: Ordena las provincias por pernoctaciones hoteleras totales de 2025, de mayor a menor.
results.reference_sql: SELECT province,SUM(nights_total) FROM fact_hotel WHERE year=2025 GROUP BY province ORDER BY SUM(nights_total) DESC
results.actual_sql: SELECT province, SUM(nights_total) AS total_nights FROM fact_hotel WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY province ORDER BY total_nights DESC

results.question: Ranking de provincias por viajeros alojados en 2024, de mayor a menor.
results.reference_sql: SELECT province,SUM(travelers_total) FROM fact_hotel WHERE year=2024 GROUP BY province ORDER BY SUM(travelers_total) DESC
results.actual_sql: SELECT province, SUM(nights_total) / SUM(travelers_total) AS mean_stay FROM fact_hotel WHERE year = 2024 GROUP BY province ORDER BY mean_stay DESC

results.question: Muestra el número de mes y las pernoctaciones de Almería de 2025, en orden de mes.
results.reference_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM period_start),SUM(nights_total) FROM fact_hotel WHERE province='Almería' AND year=2025 GROUP BY period_start ORDER BY period_start
results.actual_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM period_start) AS month, SUM(nights_total) AS nights_total FROM fact_hotel WHERE province = 'Almería' AND year = 2 - 2025 GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM period_start) ORDER BY month

results.question: Muestra el número de mes y las pernoctaciones de toda Andalucía en 2025, en orden de mes.
results.reference_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM period_start),SUM(nights_total) FROM fact_hotel WHERE year=2025 GROUP BY period_start ORDER BY period_start
results.actual_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM period_start) AS month, SUM(spend_eur) AS total_nights FROM fact_region_monthly WHERE region = 'Andalucía' AND year = 2025 GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM period_start) ORDER BY month

results.question: ¿Qué mes de 2025 tuvo más pernoctaciones hoteleras en Málaga? Devuelve número de mes y pernoctaciones.
results.reference_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM period_start),nights_total FROM fact_hotel WHERE province='Málaga' AND year=2025 ORDER BY nights_total DESC LIMIT 1
results.actual_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM period_start) AS month, SUM(nights_total) AS total_nights FROM fact_hotel WHERE province = 'Málaga' AND year = 2025 GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM period_start) ORDER BY total_nights DESC

results.question: ¿Qué provincia tuvo menos pernoctaciones hoteleras en 2025? Devuelve provincia y total.
results.reference_sql: SELECT province,SUM(nights_total) FROM fact_hotel WHERE year=2025 GROUP BY province ORDER BY SUM(nights_total) LIMIT 1
results.actual_sql: SELECT province, SUM(nights_total) AS total_nights FROM fact_hotel WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY province ORDER BY total_nights ASC LIMIT 1

results.question: Total de pernoctaciones hoteleras de residentes extranjeros en Andalucía en 2025.
results.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(nights_foreign) FROM fact_hotel WHERE year=2025
results.actual_sql: SELECT SUM(nights_foreign) AS total_nights_foreign FROM fact_hotel WHERE province = 'Andalucía' AND year = 2025

results.question: ¿Qué porcentaje de los viajeros hoteleros de Cádiz en 2024 residía en el extranjero?
results.reference_sql: SELECT 100.0*SUM(travelers_foreign)/SUM(travelers_total) FROM fact_hotel WHERE province='Cádiz' AND year=2024
results.actual_sql: SELECT (travelers_foreign * 100.0 / travelers_total) AS percentage_foreign FROM fact_hotel WHERE province = 'Cádiz' AND year = 2024 AND period_start >= '2024-01-01' AND period_start < '2025-01-01'

results.question: Estancia media agregada en hoteles de Almería durante 2025, en noches por viajero.
results.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(nights_total)/SUM(travelers_total) FROM fact_hotel WHERE province='Almería' AND year=2025
results.actual_sql: SELECT SUM(nights_total) * 1.0 / SUM(travelers_total) AS mean_stay_nights_per_traveler FROM fact_hotel WHERE province = 'Almería' AND year = 2025

results.question: Ocupación hotelera media de Andalucía de 2025, en porcentaje, ponderada por plazas y días de cada mes.
results.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(occupancy_pct*(hotel_beds*EXTRACT(DAY FROM (period_start+INTERVAL '1 month'-INTERVAL '1 day'))))/SUM(hotel_beds*EXTRACT(DAY FROM (period_start+INTERVAL '1 month'-INTERVAL '1 day'))) FROM fact_hotel WHERE year=2025
results.actual_sql: SELECT AVG(occupancy_pct) AS average_occupancy_percentage FROM fact_hotel WHERE province = 'Andalucia' AND year = 2025

results.question: Ocupación hotelera de Málaga de 2025, en porcentaje, ponderada por plazas y días de cada mes.
results.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(occupancy_pct*(hotel_beds*EXTRACT(DAY FROM (period_start+INTERVAL '1 month'-INTERVAL '1 day'))))/SUM(hotel_beds*EXTRACT(DAY FROM (period_start+INTERVAL '1 month'-INTERVAL '1 day'))) FROM fact_hotel WHERE province='Málaga' AND year=2025
results.actual_sql: SELECT occupancy_pct FROM fact_hotel WHERE province = 'Málaga' AND year = 2025

results.question: Pernoctaciones hoteleras de Almería por año, desde 2022 hasta 2025, ordenadas por año.
results.reference_sql: SELECT year,SUM(nights_total) FROM fact_hotel WHERE province='Almería' AND year BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
results.actual_sql: SELECT year, SUM(nights_total) AS total_nights FROM fact_hotel WHERE province = 'Almería' AND year BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

results.question: Porcentaje de variación de las pernoctaciones hoteleras totales de Almería entre 2024 y 2025.
results.reference_sql: SELECT 100.0*(SUM(CASE WHEN year=2025 THEN nights_total ELSE 0 END)/SUM(CASE WHEN year=2024 THEN nights_total ELSE 0 END)-1) FROM fact_hotel WHERE province='Almería' AND year IN(2024,2025)
results.actual_sql: SELECT SUM(nights_total) AS total_nights_2024, SUM(nights_total) AS total_nights_2025 FROM fact_hotel WHERE province = 'Almería' AND year = 2024 AND period_start >= '2024-10-01' AND period_start < '2025-01-01' UNION ALL SELECT SUM(nights_total) AS total_nights_2024, SUM(nights_total) AS total_nights_2025 FROM fact_hotel WHERE province = 'Almería' AND year = 2025 AND period_start >= '2025-10-01' AND period_start < '2026-01-01'
